warehouse_value: Food at home YoY 2026: Jan 2.09, Feb 2.45, Mar 1.90, Apr 2.89, May 2.74, Jun 2.75, Jul 2.68, Aug 2.19, Sep 1.81 percent. Caveat: the query's row_fanout warning comes from econ.food_cpi's annual M13 average rows sharing a year key; the month-matched joins used here are unaffected, but Oct 2025 is missing so Oct 2026 YoY is null.
sql: SELECT a.year,a.period,100*(a.value/b.value-1) FROM econ.food_cpi a JOIN econ.food_cpi b ON a.series=b.series AND a.period=b.period AND b.year=a.year-1 WHERE a.series='CUUR0000SAF11' AND a.year>=2025
